dedupe_keys.name: sepher 2 0 social vulnerability hazard risk mortgage and eviction data merged for us census tracts

description: SEPHER merges four major US datasets so that researchers can test and build metrics of inequality and climate injustice: the CDC Social Vulnerability Index, the FEMA National Risk Index, Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data and eviction data. It was created by Marco Tedesco, C. Hultquist, S. E. Char, C. Constantinides, T. Galjanic and A. D. Sinha, and version 2.0 was deposited on Zenodo on 16 March 2025 with a data paper in Environmental Justice. The sources are merged, cleaned and standardised, with every variable documented in a data dictionary; the Social Vulnerability Index contributes 15 census-derived social factors and tract rankings in four themes. Coverage: US census tracts. Access: one 573 MB CSV with dictionary on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: source years differ between the merged datasets, and derived variables inherit their limitations. Simulation uses: linking hazard risk to housing finance, evictions and social vulnerability in equity-focused resilience studies. Related records: the Harris County building population data and the Galveston testbed.
